reviews.t: Dont waste your time and money on this.
reviews.x: Product looked good at first but when installing the screen protector I noticed that the whole screen protector doesn't adhere to the phone. the edges all around doesnt have adhesive on it so it's not secure on your screen. One of the reasons why I bought a screen protector is because I'm always dropping my phone and sure enough, only 3 days with the screen protector on I drop my phone from about 3 feet high. The sad part is, before my phone even hit the ground,  the screen protector came flying

I got this for my new Note 9 & I can't stand it. I read the reviews & thought it would be a good screen protector, but it's not. I have always installed my own screen protectors in the past & have no problem with them. The install stickers wouldn't even hold it so I could put it on clean. It shows the 'sticky' edges & not even all of it adhered to the phone, which makes it look awful. It doesn't cover the whole screen, & I know that it is supposed to be a good fit to use with a case, but way too

Are all the reviews actually of this protector? I think not! Bought for a Note 9 but I see reviews for other models under this protector's heading. Anyway, though the glass is smooth, responsive and curved to fit screen, the adhesion is rediculous. One little 1/4" strip at top and bottom, the rest just floats across your screen and the whole thing will pop off very easily. The edges are rough and look "white" from the cut rather than clear. All in all, EXTREMELY DISSAPOINTED! These reviews must

I don't normally write reviews but I wanted to chime in here as the product was useless. After following the directions carefully and trying to place the screen, it never actually attached to the phone. Both screens fell off the screen. The first one fell off when I tried to just pick up the phone. The second fell off when I tried to put my otterbox case back on. Very little adhesive to get the protector to stay on the screen and noticeably dulled out the resolution. Would not recommend.

reviews.t: Read before buying - poor quality protectors
reviews.x: First off, doesn't fit the screen well. Leaves visible gaps on the edges.  Second, the picture quality with the screen protector on is noticeably dull. Third, worst screen protector I've had as far as smudging and leaving fingerprints.  I've found it very difficult to keep a clean screen.  Fourth, the packers containing the wet and dry wipes to clean the screen before application were empty. Yes, empty - no wipes inside the packets.

Absolutely horrible. First they are the floating screen protectors, just so you know. So only stick to the sides. Well it would be nice if they would actually stick all the way around and for what it did stick it wasnt longer then 2 days with normal usage. 2nd. The screen looks a different color when the screen is off making your phone look cheap and then to top it all off it shows every finger print. JUNK! DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY

reviews.t: Does its job, until it comes off. Not good.
reviews.x: Just installed this screen protector. Went on pretty easily. Two days later I dropped my phone and completely shattered the protector.  However, while it DID do it's job, it DID fall off on impact. Not good.  The next day I installed the second protector and it's been lifting off and not staying secured to the screen. This is definitely a problem with this brand of screen protectors. They will not stay on so proceed with caution.

reviews.t: Would not stick to phones screen.
reviews.x: Purchased for Samsung Galaxy Note 9. The glass would not stick to my phones screen. It stuck in spots but, not the entire screen. After one day it started to fall off. I followed the instructions to a tee. Cleaned the phone screen very well, used the parts that came with the glass, and installed it as it said and showed. I was hoping for a good product after reading the reviews. I was very let down with this screen glass!

Dont buy it this is garbage ...to thick and when u text ot try to tap on the screen tge phone does not reapond whats so ever ....i habe to presss sooo hard on the screen and i had to remove it cause i cant use the phone like this ....so please do ur self a favor buy a thin sheet of regular screen protector for ur note 9 or whate er phone u have ...DO NPT BUY THIS....WASTE OF MONEY

I gave it only 2 * because one of the glass screens was broken inside of the box when I opened it. Sad, because I was really excited to use it. The screen protector arrived on the same day my note 9 and I decided to put it on as soon as possible... we never know what could happen. Oh well... now I dont even know if I wanna keep it as a screen "protector" anymore.

This is a very low quality screen protector. The adhesive does not attavh the screen protector to the phone. Pushing the screen protector on the adhesive part will certainly break it. Even if you manage to somehow add it to the phone the touch will become spotty. That is because it does not fit to the phone at all.

I just bought this for my Samsung galaxy note 9. Only sticky part that actually connects to the screen is around the outside  don't like that it doesn't stay on very strong I can easily peel it off & dust gets under the screen.  Not the best screen protector but it works.

Almost no glue at all so the first one didn't held at all and the second one was so weak that after my girlfriend set on my phone accidentally it just the tempered glass just cracked right away (my girlfriend weights 56kg and it was on a pretty soft couch)

reviews.t: Poor craftsmanship? Not enough adhesive around edges?
reviews.x: Chipped in the corner my first day of use simply being in my pocket without anything else inside.  It was at the edge so didnt really bother me that much. By the second day the glass had mysteriously fallen off of my phone somewhere I never saw it again.

This screen protector is very poorly engineered, it doesn't provide complete coverage and the adhesive is poor at best, It really makes the Galaxy Note 9 look bad as well. Not exactly sure why this got good reviews, but I wouldn't recommend it. Junk

Product is absolutely garbage.  Just like other reviewers have said.  Not really designed for Note 9 and the first one I opened had almost no tackiness.  I applied it and it literally fell off.  Second one was no better.  Don't waste your money.

Would not recommend. I cleaned my phone and applied screen as the instructions instructed. I dropped my phone one time about 1.5 feet to the ground, screen popped off and will not lo her stick. Waste of time and money.

This product is a complete waste of money. It does not adhere to the screen. It has two very thin strips of ineffective adhesive and pops off with no effort whatsoever. It doesnt feel or sound like glass either. It

This cover is easy to apply but didn’t stay on very long.  There is no real adhesion so it can pop off easily and it did.  It really was something I wish I would not have purchased I don’t use it anymore.
Trash. Won't stick to my phone screen and after reading the reviews I noticed that multiple 5 star reviews are posted by the same people over and over. Really shady and will be returning.
The screen "protector" broke when just a little bit of pressure was applied. Does not cover edges. It also had a bubble dead center on the screen. But there were no fingerprints I guess.
This product was horrible. I followed all the instructions. Once I applied the screen saver the adhesive would not stick. This happened on both screen savers. Wouldn't buy again.
Is not glass is plastic. It does not go over the edge as described.  Hard to use keyboard have to retype. Have to keep it on till I get a real glass protector. Waste of money .

claims.text: Many reviewers report the screen protector does not adhere properly, with adhesive only on the edges and the protector falling off or lifting.
Several reviewers suspect the positive reviews are fake or fraudulent, noting discrepancies in verified purchase status and reviews for other models.
Some reviewers report touch responsiveness issues, requiring harder presses or sensitivity adjustments.
A few reviewers mention fit and quality problems such as visible gaps, dulled picture quality, smudging, or a broken protector in the box.
One reviewer notes the protector did its job absorbing impact but fell off on impact.
